title: Insurance
description: Every car's policies and when they expire

help.title: About insurance
help.overview: Each policy belongs to one car. A car is only handed over while a policy covers it until the return.

sections.title: On this page
items: Use Renew in the menu: the new record is filled from the old one and linked to it, so the history stays a chain.
Staff are warned 30 days before an expiry, and again on the day one lapses with no renewal.
A damage is linked to the policy that covered the car that day, for the claim.
